rows.review: Exposed needle and ivory cloth distinguish sewing; wooden frame/flywheel readable at 48/64.
Stone/hopper, bucket transport and flour sack remain distinguishable; compact conceptual assembly, not exact full Evans mill.

Continuous white web exiting pressing rollers remains readable at 48/64; original bright detached fleck removed by imagegen cleanup. Extremely faint residual trace at original fleck location is not discernible in reduced UI previews; no local masking was performed.

notes: All three are technology object groups, not PM pictograms or framed building scenes.
Natural brown timber and warm-neutral metals; no blue global tint.
Sources are dated designs or institutional models/reconstruction references, not claims of exact engineering replicas.
Two unchanged padded masters match initial proof hashes. Paper v1/raw and first QA boards retained; active paper v2 shown in current boards.
No DDS created or texture binding changed for this new lot; user approval remains required.
